summary.text: Robyn Vining is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing District 13, and is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Senate District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a photographer and small business owner and is not running for re-election to the Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Robyn Vining's career experience includes working as a photographer and small-business owner.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a Wauwatosa mom and small business owner who first ran for office in 2018.
Ballotpedia lists her Assembly tenure as beginning in 2019.
In the 2025-2026 session, Vining was assigned to the Assembly's Children and Families, Health, Mental Health and Small Business Development committees.

In the 2024 survey she said she chairs the Milwaukee Delegation and listed mental health care, fair maps, public schools, affordable child care and reproductive freedom among the topics she has focused on as a legislator.
She gave her key messages as affordable, accessible health care; adequate funding for public education; and finding common ground on shared values.
